description: Confirmation fields for day-zero support of a new checkpoint or architecture. These fields have no task-input/v1 home; they stay in the intake record and the task summary until a later task-file version defines them.

fields.question: Which checkpoint or weights must the target engine load?
Which tokenizer or processor accompanies the checkpoint?
Which engine revision and target device must run the model?
Which modalities or features must the first supported scope cover?
Which reference implementation produces the expected outputs?
Which replayable inputs and fixtures anchor the stage-by-stage comparison?
Which numeric or output-consistency criteria define supported behavior per stage?
